#### Veeam

**Security and Compliance Analyzer**

This dashboard gives visibility into Security and Compliance Analyzer in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and passed checks, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces top users, top hosts, and analyzer event codes. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a security-and-compliance view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
